findings.summary: No test covers the archived bookmarks page in the browser or the HTML view. Criterion 4 is checked only through /api/bookmarks/archived/.
findings.failure_scenario: The archived page view stops passing the `sort` query parameter to `query_archived_bookmarks`, or uses a separate form without the new choices. Then 'Modified ↑/↓' on /bookmarks/archived does nothing, but every test still passes because only the API path for archived bookmarks is checked.

findings.summary: The fallback test also passes on the code before the change. That is expected for a regression guard, but it is not evidence of the new feature.
findings.failure_scenario: The test passes both before and after the change, so on its own it cannot tell whether modified sorting exists. It does catch the real risk: the fixture's modified order (third, first, second) differs from added-desc (third, second, first), so a change that made the else branch sort by date_modified would fail it. Nothing to fix; note only that it does not count toward the rule that every test must fail before the change.
